sources.label: Patches for the Wykop.pl app, for use with Morphe
sources.author: HagiaHaya
patch_list: Adds the built-in mini-game to the menu shown when you long-press the Jakdojade icon. Open Jakdojade once to add the shortcut.
Allows signing in with Google, finding the location and receiving notifications by using MicroG-RE instead of Google Play services.

Unlocks the premium features, such as hiding ads, offline timetables and departure notifications, without a subscription. Also turns on the hidden test premium developer flag so the account screen and billing report premium as active.
